name: manageAvatarScript
description: Make a video of an avatar that sings or speaks, with its mouth following the words. sing: the avatar sings a song made with JingleScript; render the song first (manageJingleScript, renderScore, with a `lyric` on the sung notes), then pass the `audioFile` and `timingFile` it answered. speak: the avatar says a script, text with directions such as [emotion:happy] and <nod>; action getGuide gives the syntax. The video takes about as long to make as it lasts. The video is shown to the user in a player.

action.description: What to do. sing: a video of the avatar singing a JingleScript song. speak: a video of the avatar saying a script. getGuide: how to write a script.

audioFile.description: sing: path of the song's audio, the `audioFile` that manageJingleScript's renderScore answered.

timingFile.description: sing: path of the song's timing map, the `timingFile` that renderScore answered. The mouth follows its lyric syllables.

script.description: speak: what the avatar says, with directions inline: "[emotion:happy] Hello! <nod>". getGuide gives the syntax.

emotion.description: sing: the avatar's emotion for the whole song (default neutral). In a script, [emotion:NAME] sets it.

subtitles.description: true draws the words over the video: each lyric line while it is sung, or each sentence while it is spoken.

tts.description: speak: the text-to-speech provider; leave out to use the one this computer is set up for.

voice.description: speak: the provider's voice id; leave out for the avatar's own voice.

avatar.description: The avatar: an https URL of an avatar package folder. Leave out for the default avatar.

fileName.description: File stem of the video (default "song" for sing, "speech" for speak). A name that is taken becomes "<stem>-2", "<stem>-3" …
